title: Programming Code Assistant — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Explains, writes, and debugs code for coursework in plain language. The Programming Code Assistant explains, writes, and debugs code. It explains what a piece of code does line by line, writes working code from a plain description, and debugs errors by locating the fault, explaining the cause, and showing the fix. Every explanation teaches the concept behind the code so the student can write the next program alone.
capabilities: Explain code line by line in plain language
Write working code from a description
Debug errors: locate, explain, fix
Teach the concept behind the code
Review code for style and correctness
